verdict.rationale: GitLab Duo docs mention AI agents that 'review code while your team stays in control' and findings appear in merge requests, suggesting AI-assisted review is possible, but there's no explicit documentation of assigning an AI reviewer as the initial reviewer of a merge request for faster turnaround. Missing for 10: explicit workflow/documentation showing AI-reviewer assignment as MR reviewer, evidence of turnaround-time improvement, and independent/hands-on confirmation.
